```{=html}
<main id="quarto-document-content" class="faq-page">
  <section class="faq-hero">
    <div class="site-grid">
      <nav class="breadcrumbs" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
        <a href="index.html">Cloud Services</a>
        <span aria-hidden="true">/</span>
        <span aria-current="page">FAQ</span>
      </nav>
      <div class="faq-hero__heading">
        <div>
          <p class="home-eyebrow">
            <span aria-hidden="true"></span>
            Help center
          </p>
          <h1>Frequently asked questions</h1>
          <p>
            Find quick answers about access, Coder cloud workspaces, the AI
            Gateway, and common technical questions.
          </p>
        </div>
        <span class="hexagon-motif" aria-hidden="true">
          <i></i>
          <i></i>
          <i></i>
        </span>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-search">
        <span class="faq-search__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <label class="sr-only" for="faq-search-input">
          Search frequently asked questions
        </label>
        <input
          id="faq-search-input"
          type="search"
          placeholder="Search questions, topics, or keywords"
          autocomplete="off"
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          id="faq-search-clear"
          aria-label="Clear search"
          hidden
        >
          Clear
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="site-grid faq-content" id="faq-topics-container" aria-live="polite">
    <p class="faq-results" id="faq-results-summary" hidden></p>

    <section class="faq-topic faq-topic--coral" data-topic="Accounts">
      <div class="faq-topic__heading">
        <div>
          <p>Topic</p>
          <h2>Accounts</h2>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-list">
        <article class="faq-item is-open">
          <h3>
            <button type="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="faq-accounts-0">
              <span>Who can use DREAM Lab Cloud Services?</span>
              <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
            </button>
          </h3>
          <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-accounts-0">
            <p>
              Anyone with an active UCSB NetID (students, faculty, and staff) can
              sign in at <a href="https://coder.dreamlab.ucsb.edu">coder.dreamlab.ucsb.edu</a>
              and create a Coder workspace for the duration of the academic quarter.
            </p>
          </div>
        </article>
        <article class="faq-item">
          <h3>
            <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-accounts-1">
              <span>How do I sign in to Coder?</span>
              <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
            </button>
          </h3>
          <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-accounts-1" hidden>
            <p>
              Visit <a href="https://coder.dreamlab.ucsb.edu">coder.dreamlab.ucsb.edu</a>,
              click <strong>UCSB Login</strong>, and authenticate using UCSB Single
              Sign-On (via Google) with your UCSB NetID.
            </p>
          </div>
        </article>
        <article class="faq-item">
          <h3>
            <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-accounts-2">
              <span>How many workspaces can I create?</span>
              <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
            </button>
          </h3>
          <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-accounts-2" hidden>
            <p>
              Users may create and use only one workspace at a time. Multiple
              active workspaces may be deleted without notice to conserve shared
              computing resources.
            </p>
          </div>
        </article>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="faq-topic faq-topic--gold" data-topic="Workspaces">
      <div class="faq-topic__heading">
        <div>
          <p>Topic</p>
          <h2>Workspaces</h2>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-list">
        <article class="faq-item">
          <h3>
            <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-workspaces-0">
              <span>What hardware and software are included in a Coder workspace?</span>
              <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
            </button>
          </h3>
          <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-workspaces-0" hidden>
            <p>
              Each workspace is an Ubuntu Linux virtual machine with 4 vCPUs,
              16 GiB RAM, and a 64 GB user data disk. It includes Docker, Pixi,
              R, Python (<code>uv</code>/<code>uvx</code>), Git, and GitHub CLI,
              plus optional RStudio Server, JupyterLab, and VS Code Web/Desktop.
              See the <a href="coder.html">Coder Overview</a> for full specifications.
            </p>
          </div>
        </article>
        <article class="faq-item">
          <h3>
            <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-workspaces-1">
              <span>Will my files remain after I stop a workspace?</span>
              <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
            </button>
          </h3>
          <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-workspaces-1" hidden>
            <p>
              Yes. Stopping a workspace releases active compute resources while
              preserving files in your persistent home directory during the
              quarter. However, <strong>deleting</strong> a workspace permanently
              removes all files, and <strong>all workspaces are automatically deleted at the end of each academic quarter</strong>. Always back up your data.
            </p>
          </div>
        </article>
        <article class="faq-item">
          <h3>
            <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-workspaces-2">
              <span>How long can I leave a workspace running?</span>
              <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
            </button>
          </h3>
          <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-workspaces-2" hidden>
            <p>
              Workspaces automatically shut down (stop) after <strong>four hours</strong>
              of inactivity to conserve shared resources. You can restart a
              stopped workspace at any time by clicking the <strong>Start</strong> button.
            </p>
          </div>
        </article>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="faq-topic faq-topic--green" data-topic="AI Gateway">
      <div class="faq-topic__heading">
        <div>
          <p>Topic</p>
          <h2>AI Gateway</h2>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-list">
        <article class="faq-item">
          <h3>
            <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-gateway-0">
              <span>What is the DREAM Lab AI Gateway?</span>
              <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
            </button>
          </h3>
          <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-gateway-0" hidden>
            <p>
              The <a href="guides/ai-gateway.html">DREAM Lab AI Gateway</a> is an
              experimental service providing OpenAI-compatible API access
              (<code>https://litellm.dreamlab.ucsb.edu/v1</code>) to LLMs hosted
              by campus cloud providers. Anyone with a UCSB NetID can generate a
              personal API key via the <a href="https://litellm.dreamlab.ucsb.edu/dreamlab-keys">API key manager</a>.
            </p>
          </div>
        </article>
        <article class="faq-item">
          <h3>
            <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-gateway-1">
              <span>Can I send sensitive research data to a model or store it in a workspace?</span>
              <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
            </button>
          </h3>
          <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-gateway-1" hidden>
            <p>
              No. Neither Coder Workspaces nor the DREAM Lab AI Gateway are
              approved for confidential, sensitive, or restricted data classified
              as <strong>P3</strong> or <strong>P4</strong> under UC data
              protection levels.
            </p>
          </div>
        </article>
        <article class="faq-item">
          <h3>
            <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-gateway-2">
              <span>Which AI coding agents are supported?</span>
              <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
            </button>
          </h3>
          <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-gateway-2" hidden>
            <p>
              OpenCode is pre-installed and pre-configured on Coder Workspaces to
              work with both the DREAM Lab AI Gateway and College IT's AI Gateway.
              See <a href="guides/ai-agents.html">Using AI Coding Agents</a> and
              <a href="guides/ucsb_ai_commons.html">UCSB AI Commons API</a> for
              setup instructions.
            </p>
          </div>
        </article>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="faq-topic faq-topic--aqua" data-topic="Troubleshooting">
      <div class="faq-topic__heading">
        <div>
          <p>Topic</p>
          <h2>Troubleshooting</h2>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-list">
        <article class="faq-item">
          <h3>
            <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-trouble-0">
              <span>How do I enable RStudio if I already created a workspace?</span>
              <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
            </button>
          </h3>
          <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-trouble-0" hidden>
            <p>
              RStudio Server must be enabled when the workspace is first created;
              it cannot be added to an existing workspace. Back up any files you
              need, delete the workspace, and create a new workspace with
              <strong>Include RStudio</strong> set to <strong>Yes</strong>.
            </p>
          </div>
        </article>
        <article class="faq-item">
          <h3>
            <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-trouble-1">
              <span>How do I transfer files in and out of my workspace?</span>
              <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
            </button>
          </h3>
          <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-trouble-1" hidden>
            <p>
              You can use the built-in <strong>File Browser</strong> from the
              workspace dashboard, send files between machines with
              <code>uvx magic-wormhole</code>, or connect to Google Drive with
              <code>rclone</code>. See our <a href="guides/file-transfer.html">Transferring Files guide</a>.
            </p>
          </div>
        </article>
        <article class="faq-item">
          <h3>
            <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-trouble-2">
              <span>Where can I get help with a technical issue?</span>
              <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
            </button>
          </h3>
          <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-trouble-2" hidden>
            <p>
              Email the DREAM Lab team at <a href="mailto:dreamlab@library.ucsb.edu">dreamlab@library.ucsb.edu</a>
              or join the <a href="https://join.slack.com/t/ucsbcarpentry/shared_invite/zt-3chxqtb2b-cVc3l~yj1ghUhZLNmOLfhQ">UCSB Carpentry Slack</a>.
            </p>
          </div>
        </article>
      </div>
    </section>

    <div class="faq-empty" id="faq-empty-state" hidden>
      <h2>No matching questions</h2>
      <p>Try a broader search, or reach out to the DREAM Lab team at <a href="mailto:dreamlab@library.ucsb.edu">dreamlab@library.ucsb.edu</a>.</p>
      <button type="button" id="faq-empty-reset">Clear search</button>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  var items = document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item');
  items.forEach(function (item) {
    var btn = item.querySelector('h3 button');
    var answer = item.querySelector('.faq-item__answer');
    if (!btn || !answer) return;
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var isOpen = item.classList.contains('is-open');
      if (isOpen) {
        item.classList.remove('is-open');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        answer.hidden = true;
      } else {
        item.classList.add('is-open');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        answer.hidden = false;
      }
    });
  });

  var searchInput = document.getElementById('faq-search-input');
  var clearBtn = document.getElementById('faq-search-clear');
  var emptyResetBtn = document.getElementById('faq-empty-reset');
  var summaryEl = document.getElementById('faq-results-summary');
  var emptyEl = document.getElementById('faq-empty-state');
  var topics = document.querySelectorAll('.faq-topic');

  function filterFaq() {
    var q = (searchInput.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    clearBtn.hidden = !q;
    var totalMatches = 0;

    topics.forEach(function (topicSection) {
      var topicName = (topicSection.getAttribute('data-topic') || '').toLowerCase();
      var topicItems = topicSection.querySelectorAll('.faq-item');
      var visibleInTopic = 0;

      topicItems.forEach(function (item) {
        var text = item.textContent.toLowerCase();
        var match = !q || text.indexOf(q) !== -1 || topicName.indexOf(q) !== -1;
        item.hidden = !match;
        if (match) {
          visibleInTopic++;
          totalMatches++;
          if (q) {
            item.classList.add('is-open');
            var btn = item.querySelector('h3 button');
            var ans = item.querySelector('.faq-item__answer');
            if (btn) btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
            if (ans) ans.hidden = false;
          }
        }
      });

      topicSection.hidden = visibleInTopic === 0;
    });

    if (q) {
      summaryEl.hidden = false;
      summaryEl.innerHTML = totalMatches + ' result' + (totalMatches === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' for <strong>“' +
        searchInput.value.replace(/</g, '&lt;') + '”</strong>';
    } else {
      summaryEl.hidden = true;
    }

    emptyEl.hidden = totalMatches > 0;
  }

  if (searchInput) {
    searchInput.addEventListener('input', filterFaq);
  }
  if (clearBtn) {
    clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      searchInput.value = '';
      filterFaq();
      searchInput.focus();
    });
  }
  if (emptyResetBtn) {
    emptyResetBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      searchInput.value = '';
      filterFaq();
      searchInput.focus();
    });
  }
});
</script>
```
